messages.plugin-builder.help.title: Plugin Studio
messages.plugin-builder.help.what: Describe a custom tool in plain language to design, build, test safely, and install only when you’re happy with it.
messages.plugin-builder.help.example-1: Describe a recurring checklist or tracker and review the proposed design
messages.plugin-builder.help.example-2: Try it with sample data in preview before installing to your project or personal space
messages.plugin-builder.help.scope: Design and generation use your connected text model (billed by the provider); generated plugins run in an isolated environment with only the permissions you approve.
messages.plugin-builder.help.advanced: Preview runs never alter live project data; later revisions upgrade cleanly on your confirmation while keeping stored data.
